purpose: The full-screen interactive homepage, inspected both as a complete landscape and at close zoom
required_parts: bridges, paths, planting, lighting and facade details
relations: terrain heights continue across tile seams
buildings and vegetation seat on terrain
equipment has supports and connected structure
style: pale ceramic, glass, brushed metal, yellow accents and mint vegetation

surface_targets: no blockout residue at maximum interactive zoom

review_questions: Does the landscape feel like one designed place?
Does every zone reward closer inspection?
Are destinations recognizable without floating labels?
Do roads, supports and roofs actually connect?

performance.strategy: merge meshes by material and region, simplify only details invisible at required view distance
performance.target: smooth desktop and usable mobile pan/zoom; measure in the actual browser
